observed_at_design: Data dictionary, column types, missingness, IDs, years, overall detection count and feature-zero counts have been inspected. No geometry contrast has yet been calculated.
comparison: Environmental/resource-feature geometry of detection-positive trap records versus uniformly drawn equal-size samples of all surveyed trap opportunities; nondetections are not certified biological absences.
feature_rationale: 5km landscape resource scale is motivated by the already published 5-6km finding, NOT selected by the current readout. Host cover and nearest-host distance are resource/landscape proxies, not independent full A/B/M axes.
reference: One all-survey reference per feature panel: fixed median center and population standard-deviation scale after log1p. Unlike within-group scaling, preserves comparative extent. Shared MAD is zero for zero-inflated HPC_5, so SD is deliberately specified before geometry scoring. Constant flag only if actual range is zero.
metrics: environmental largest/median positive MST edge (descriptive gap)

nulls.conditional_primary: preserve detection-positive count in each district_ID x year x oak_species stratum, sample uniformly without replacement from that stratum

report: Observed values, null medians, ratios, 5th/95th null sensitivity quantiles and exploratory two-sided rank probabilities (not confirmatory p values). Keep both nulls and all panels regardless of direction.
robustness: Delete each of26 districts in turn, keep full reference fixed, recompute observed primary span and199 conditional matched draws. Report sign stability, not26 independent tests.
spatial_topology: Not estimable: no coordinates or explicit landscape graph in released CSV. Environmental MST is not geographic connectivity.
limitations: Published reduced data omit122 nominal records and later years; omission mechanism unknown.
No trapping effort/detection-repeat columns: results concern observed captures conditional on placement, not true occupancy or demographic persistence.
HPC and Ci arise from the host landscape: no causal or independent BAM-axis decomposition.
No row-level pooled independence assumption or out-of-sample predictive superiority.
No reopening of EOG-WF3/31/3 and no fourth predictive endpoint.
